assignments.brief_reason: Supports removal for misinformation and threatening/racist/inciting-violence rhetoric.
Seeks balance and treats party framing as not decisive, aligning with consistent standards across sides.
Describes pairing as similarity/difference comparison, not clearly about moderation standards or threat/toxicity thresholds.
Removal is based on emotionally framed toxicity/evil.
Prioritizes free speech and visibility of opposing viewpoints unless threats are present.
Looks for attacks vs opinion within the pair; fits content cueing but not explicitly in the provided threat/toxicity frameworks.
Uses avoidance of cursing/personal attacks as a moderation criterion (toxicity-related), though framed as appropriateness.
Mentions a terms-elimination process without clear mapping to toxicity/threat or consistent cross-side moderation.
Gates removal on factual denial/authenticity, which aligns with removing misinformation.
Normatively wants better comments due to rudeness, but doesn’t specify the codebook’s violence/toxicity removal standard.
Direct bullying/derisive wording is a negative cue driving removal.
Avoids swearing/cruelty; aligns with removing excessively vulgar/cruel or toxic content.
Only rejects content when it incites violence; otherwise allows both viewpoints.
Notes statements can be valid despite disagreement; doesn’t clearly fit a specific moderation/threat/toxicity theme.
Focuses on limiting name-calling/cursing as the criterion for keep/remove.
Uses tone/language to predict productive conversation, without explicit threat/toxicity/free-speech rule matching.
Removes mainly mean/insulting content rather than substantive argument; overlaps with toxicity/bullying removal.
Wants reasonableness even without agreement and excludes calls for violence (threat exception).
Uses contextual meaning from both versions; doesn’t specify the moderation principles in the themes.
Removes aggressive/trolling content and notes views aren’t largely different; not clearly tied to the threat/toxicity or cross-side consistency themes as defined.
